<!--
Precipitation across ecosystem
-->

```{r rainfall_text, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (is.null(params$rainfall)) {
  rain_text <- ""
} else {
  rain_text <- paste0(
    # "**Rainfall:** ",
    "Historical rainfall data was taken from [WorldClim version 2.1](https://www.worldclim.org/data/worldclim21.html). The average annual rainfall with the ecosystem between 1970 and 2000 was ", round(mean(params$rainfall$mean), 1), "mm. The average monthly rainfall patterns are shown in the graph below:"
    )
}
```

`r rain_text`

```{r rainfall, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE,  fig.align = "center", out.width = '100%', fig.height=3, eval = !is.null(params$rainfall)}
monthly_avg <- params$rainfall

if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
  # --- Interactive Plotly ---
  library(plotly)
  p_plot <- plot_ly(monthly_avg, x = ~month) %>%
  add_ribbons(
    ymin = ~min_smooth,
    ymax = ~max_smooth,
    line = list(color = 'transparent'),
    fillcolor = 'lightblue',
    opacity = 0.4,
    name = "95% range"
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    y = ~mean_smooth,
    line = list(color = 'blue', width = 2),
    name = "Mean"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Average Monthly Rainfall",
    xaxis = list(title = "Month"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Rainfall (mm)")
  )

  # return plot
  p_plot
  
} else {
  # --- Static ggplot for PDF/Word ---
   p_plot <- ggplot(monthly_avg, aes(x = month, group=1)) +
  # smoothed ribbon
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min_smooth, ymax = max_smooth),
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.4) +

  # smoothed mean line
    geom_line(aes(y = mean_smooth), color = "blue", size = 1) +
    labs(title = "Average Monthly Rainfall",
       x = "Month",
       y = "Rainfall (mm)")+
    theme_classic() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype=5, linewidth=0.5, color="grey50"))

   p_plot
}
```
